faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.subtitle: Transparency at every step, from hiring to launch.

items.question: How much does a landing page with Rickz cost?
items.answer: With the Professional plan, development costs R$ 800 as a one-time payment. Hosting, support and maintenance cost R$ 200 per month during the initial 6-month contract, bringing the total to R$ 2,000 for that period. The domain is purchased and paid for separately. The other packages and their prices are listed in the investment section.

items.question: What does the R$ 200 monthly fee include?
items.answer: The Professional plan's monthly fee includes hosting, technical support, preventive maintenance, fixes for issues that are Rickz's responsibility and minor updates within the agreed limits.

items.question: Do I have to keep paying after the 6 months?
items.answer: No. Once the initial 6-month contract has been fulfilled, renewal is optional. You decide whether to continue with hosting, support and maintenance.

items.question: Will I lose my landing page if I cancel support?
items.answer: No. After fulfilling the six months, you can request the files needed to publish your landing page with another hosting provider at no additional cost, subject to applicable rights and licenses. Setting up the new hosting may be charged separately. Service will end on the agreed date, with the transition period communicated in advance.

items.question: How long will it take to build my landing page?
items.answer: The estimated delivery time is 7 to 30 calendar days, depending on the project's complexity and receipt of the required materials.

items.question: Can I request changes after launch?
items.answer: Yes. The monthly fee includes up to three simple requests per month, limited to 30 minutes each. Unused requests do not roll over. New features and larger changes are charged separately. Fixes for bugs that are Rickz's responsibility do not count towards this allowance.

items.question: Will the domain be registered in my name?
items.answer: The domain is purchased separately and should preferably be registered in your name, so you retain control of that address.

items.question: Will my landing page guarantee more sales?
items.answer: There is no sales guarantee. Your page will be structured to present the offer clearly, highlight its benefits and make conversions easier. Results also depend on the audience, product, price and traffic reaching the page.

process.title: From idea to launch
